title: Ferrero Rocher cake near Northmead or Winston Hills? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Ferrero Rocher cake for Northmead or Winston Hills, with no egg anywhere in it? Harris Park makes it.

Hazelnut, chocolate and a crisp centre, built on an oil-based eggless sponge. The oil is why it stays moist on day three, not just day one. Every Num Num's cake is 100% eggless, so nobody at the table has to ask.

Order two days ahead. Collect from Wigram Street, Harris Park, 11am to 10pm. Most Northmead and Winston Hills families are here in under 25 minutes.

Photo reference or your own design? Send it with the order.
